admission.justification: A future tokenizer change must not silently alter word boundaries or drop unspaced text while claiming the retained whitespace-token contract.

applicability: The recorded reviewer/reader 4 choice of MIK-R67@v2 rule18, or the explicit F07 resource ruling for one-spilled-history.
conditions: Split tokens on the supplied whitespace definition, retaining unspaced and zero-width-space passages whole.
MIK-R35 rule2 chooses whitespace splitting; the rewrite presentation retains the complete supplied strings rather than hiding such passages.
exclusions: No natural-language segmentation, Unicode grapheme guarantee or original-file byte-decoding authenticity is claimed.
This is a source-bound future boundary, not a fresh runtime, visual, suite or independent MEMORY verdict.
statement: Text without spaces is one token; a zero-width space is not whitespace. MIK-R35 rule 2 splits on whitespace. Such a passage reads as a rewrite with both texts in full; nothing is hidden.
